sloka: वचन अन्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा ।अवदत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् गत चेतसम् ॥४-२५-१२॥
transliteration: vacana ante tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā ।avadat praśritam vākyam sugrīvam gata cetasam ॥4-25-12॥

translations.english: Seeing Sugriva had lost his senses, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemy warriors humbly said at the end of Rama's address:
